rules.name: 15+ Year Web Persistence
rules.description: Page or host has been continuously archived and accessible for over 15 years.

rules.name: Domain / URL Resurrection
rules.description: URL was active, disappeared for >= 2 years (404/NXDOMAIN), and returned with active content.

rules.name: Unlisted Sitemap Discovery
rules.description: Valid sitemap XML found at non-standard or unlinked endpoints.

rules.name: Robots.txt Historical Discrepancy
rules.description: Robots.txt contains anomalous disallow directives pointing to forgotten endpoints or fossil paths.

rules.name: Historical Technology Fossil
rules.description: Markup contains legacy technologies (e.g., Macromedia Flash, FrontPage, Netscape tags, XHTML 1.0, archaic CMS).

rules.name: Abrupt Structural / Tech Shift
rules.description: Drastic content length, DOM structure, or tech-stack shift observed in temporal timeline.

rules.name: Low Discoverability / Zero Inbound
rules.description: Page is not linked from homepage or main navigation yet remains publicly live.

rules.name: Orphaned Surviving Subpage
rules.description: Deep subpage active while parent directory or homepage has been retired or replaced.

rules.name: Forgotten Public File / Directory Index
rules.description: Open directory index or exposed backup/archive directory on a live server.
